route_note: High-speed trains run directly from Nanjing South to Yangzhou in about an hour, with the station connected to the old town by local bus or taxi.
Frequent high-speed trains from Nanjing South reach Zhenjiang in about 30 minutes, then a local bus or short taxi ride goes to the temples and hill sites.
High-speed trains from Nanjing South take about 20-30 minutes to Ma'anshan, from where local buses reach the riverside and Caishi sites.
see: Pilgrimage to the poetry sites along the Yangtze

route_note: High-speed trains from Nanjing South reach Chuzhou in roughly 20 minutes, then a local bus or taxi continues to Langya Mountain.
tour_query: Langya Mountain day trip from Nanjing
